title: SEPPA SSB-R10: Rotary PET Bottle Blowing Machine for High Volume Production Lines
overviewTitle: Overview of the SEPPA SSB-R10 Rotary PET Bottle Blowing Machine
overviewDescription: Rotary blow molding solved a problem that linear systems never fully cracked: how do you keep ten cavities producing bottles at identical wall thickness, hour after hour, without one station drifting out of spec and contaminating the reject bin? The SEPPA SSB-R10 is Seppa Solutions' answer to that challenge, built around a 10 cavity rotary carousel that treats consistency across every station as the primary engineering target, not just peak throughput.
overviewsubDescription: Ten cavities running in continuous rotation means the SSB-R10 occupies a production tier where output volume starts competing with dedicated high speed lines, but without the footprint or capital commitment those installations demand. For bottlers operating in that middle ground, between outgrowing an 8 cavity platform and not quite needing a 16 station system, this rotary PET blow molding machine fills the gap precisely.

Seppa engineered this platform around the principle that adding cavities should not mean adding variability. Every station on the SSB-R10 shares a single master cam reference and servo synchronized drive, so thermal exposure, stretch timing, and blow pressure stay locked together regardless of which cavity a preform enters. That mechanical discipline is what separates a genuine 10 cavity production machine from a lower cavity count design stretched beyond its design envelope.
featuresTitle: Key Features and Technical Specifications of the SSB-R10

features.title: 10 Station Servo Synchronized Carousel
features.description: A single master cam reference governs all ten blow stations simultaneously, eliminating the cavity to cavity timing drift that plagues independently driven systems. The servo synchronized drive train maintains angular precision across the full speed range, ensuring that station ten produces the same wall thickness distribution as station one throughout an entire production run.

features.title: Advanced Multi Zone IR Heating
features.description: The thermal conditioning tunnel uses independently adjustable infrared lamp banks across multiple heating zones, with reflector geometry optimized for even energy distribution across the preform surface. Rotating spindles ensure circumferential uniformity while zone by zone control allows operators to fine tune heat input based on preform weight and resin grade without mechanical changeover.

features.title: Electronically Staged Blow Pressure
features.description: Pre blow and high pressure blow phases are electronically timed per cavity rather than mechanically cammed, giving operators the ability to adjust pressure profiles for different preform geometries through the HMI. An integrated air recovery system captures exhaust air from the blow phase and recirculates it to pre blow stages, reducing compressed air consumption by up to 25 percent without affecting cycle time.

applicationsTitle: Applications Across Beverage and Packaging Industries
applicationsSubtitle: The SSB-R10's ten cavity configuration positions it for production volumes that demand more than an 8 cavity system can deliver, while maintaining the format flexibility that single product dedicated lines sacrifice.

applications.title: High Volume Water Bottling
applications.description: Still and sparkling water lines running lightweight preforms at maximum speed demand absolute consistency in base geometry and wall distribution. The SSB-R10's synchronized carousel maintains that consistency across all ten stations, even when running the thinnest commercially viable preform weights.

applications.title: CSD and Pressurized Containers
applications.description: Carbonated soft drink bottles require higher internal pressure resistance, which translates to tighter control over material distribution in the base and shoulder regions. The electronically staged blow pressure system allows CSD specific profiles to be stored and recalled without mechanical adjustment.

applications.title: Multi SKU Flexible Production
applications.description: Bottlers running multiple bottle formats across a production week benefit from the SSB-R10's rapid mold changeover system, which minimizes the downtime penalty of switching between container sizes and shapes. The ability to store and recall heating and blow profiles per SKU reduces the requalification time after each changeover.

whyChoose.title: Why Choose Seppa Solutions for the SSB-R10?
whyChoose.description: Seppa Solutions approaches every SSB-R10 installation as a system integration project, not a standalone equipment sale. The engineering team works through preform selection, mold design, downstream conveyor layout, and control system architecture before the machine reaches the factory floor.
paragraphs: That systems level thinking is why FMCG bottlers with multi line facilities return to Seppa for capacity expansions. The SSB-R10's control architecture is designed to integrate with upstream preform handling and downstream filling and capping equipment on a shared communication backbone, so the entire line runs as one coordinated system rather than a collection of independently timed machines.

Seppa's field service infrastructure backs the hardware with documentation designed for rapid fault isolation, structured maintenance calendars, and spare parts logistics that keep unplanned downtime to a minimum. For a bottler investing in a 10 cavity rotary platform for the next decade, that ongoing support relationship is as important as the machine's rated output.

methodology.title: Methodology of the SSB-R10 PET Bottle Blowing Process
methodology.subtitle: The continuous motion production sequence follows a precisely timed path through each process zone:

steps.title: Continuous Preform Infeed
steps.description: Preforms load from a hopper through an orientation and singulation system onto the carousel spindles at a rate precisely matched to the blow cycle, ensuring no starvation or backup at the infeed point.

steps.title: Multi Zone Thermal Conditioning
steps.description: Infrared lamp banks bring each preform to its optimal stretch temperature while rotating spindles ensure circumferential uniformity. Zone by zone control compensates for preform geometry variations without stopping the line.

steps.title: Synchronized Stretch Blow Molding
steps.description: Heated preforms transfer to the blow stations where servo driven stretch rods and electronically staged air pressure execute biaxial orientation. Pre blow shapes the preform into rough conformity, followed by high pressure final blow exceeding 35 bar to complete wall formation.

steps.title: Automated Discharge and Air Recovery
steps.description: Finished bottles eject onto a discharge conveyor synchronized with downstream filling equipment. Simultaneously, the air recovery system captures exhaust air and redirects it to pre blow functions on other stations, closing the energy loop.

outro: This continuous sequence eliminates the dead time between cycles that limits linear system throughput, allowing the SSB-R10 to sustain output rates that would require multiple linear machines running in parallel to match.

faqs.question: What output rates can the SSB-R10 achieve?
faqs.answer: Output depends on bottle size and preform weight, but the 10 cavity configuration delivers significantly higher sustained throughput than 6 or 8 cavity platforms while maintaining wall thickness consistency across all stations throughout extended production runs.

faqs.question: How does the SSB-R10 handle changeovers between bottle formats?
faqs.answer: The rapid mold changeover system minimizes mechanical downtime, while stored heating and blow pressure profiles for each SKU reduce the requalification time after a format switch. Most changeovers can be completed within a single maintenance window.

faqs.question: What maintenance does a 10 cavity rotary system require?
faqs.answer: Structured maintenance focuses on IR lamp condition, blow station seal integrity, cam track lubrication, and servo drive calibration. Seppa provides detailed maintenance calendars tailored to each installation's run hours and product mix.

faqs.question: Can the SSB-R10 integrate with existing filling and capping lines?
faqs.answer: Yes. The SSB-R10's control architecture is designed for shared communication with downstream equipment, so blowing, filling, and capping run as one synchronized line rather than independently timed stations.

faqs.question: Why choose a 10 cavity system over adding a second smaller machine?
faqs.answer: A single 10 cavity rotary platform requires less floor space, fewer operators, lower total energy consumption, and simpler maintenance scheduling than two smaller machines producing equivalent combined output. The single master cam reference also delivers better cavity to cavity consistency than two independent systems.
